jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production decorative bitmap for an actual fantasy desktop UI. References are MATERIAL AND PALETTE references: image 1 is our earlier generated soft warm sheep-parchment, image 2 our earlier generated walnut leather. Retain that unified warm ivory/ochre/walnut/aged brass palette. The user says the recent polished gold rectangle looks too formal; return to a tactile sword-and-magic scholar's parchment scroll and handmade grimoire. Detailed painterly material, fibrous vellum, fine soft wrinkles and folds, worn rounded edges, delicate sepia penwork and very small old brass fasteners. Calm legible center. No characters, wording, glyphs, numerals, icons, logos, scientific data or UI labels. No neon, silver, green/purple/burgundy variants, gilded picture-frame mouldings, baroque palace-frame bevels, metal cartouches, continuous straight gold rails, heavy burn damage or excessive grunge. True transparent background outside the isolated asset. Front-on orthographic 2D, no perspective room or cast shadow on an external background. Create ONE 4:3 rectangular OPEN-CENTER parchment scroll edge assembly, 1448x1086 if possible. This asset is a narrow four-sided border, not a filled sheet. The entire broad middle rectangle MUST be transparent. Give it soft irregular parchment edging backed by a very narrow aged brown leather strip; top/bottom edges have modest naturally curled paper lips, hand-sewn binding details, little twine ties at the four corners, very sparse antique-gold leaf penwork rather than thick metal sculpture. Keep all material concentrated in a narrow 4-6% perimeter, complete uncut corner curls within the canvas. Treat it as the rim of an unfolded mage's working folio with organic contour, handmade warmth and nuanced sheep-skin fibers. No huge scroll rollers, no central medallion, no embedded buttons. Leave transparent padding 1% around the whole isolated object.
